title: Fulfillment-Delay Allowance for Late Marketplace Orders Deliveries
content:
**Rule.** The fulfillment-delay allowance of the Marketplace Orders late-delivery compensation measures the handling overrun as the calendar days from the order date to the shipped date, less the option's maximum handling business days: an overrun of at least the long-overrun days of 2 earns the long-overrun allowance of USD 4.00; an overrun of at least the short-overrun days of 1 but fewer than 2 earns the short-overrun allowance of USD 2.00; any other shipment earns no fulfillment-delay allowance.

The allowance is added in full to the late-delivery compensation owed on the order. It is not owed on an order that is owed no late-delivery compensation.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| order date | the order record |
| shipped date | the order record (the date of the first carrier scan of the shipment) |
| maximum handling business days | the figure of the order's delivery option in the product's service standards |

Handling overrun: the calendar days from the order date to the shipped date, less the option's maximum handling business days (the subtraction is of the option's figure as it stands, with no conversion between calendar and business days).

| Handling overrun | Allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 4.00 |
| 1 | 2.00 |
| 0 or less | 0.00 |

## Hypothetical cases

1. An order placed on 3 March on an option whose maximum handling is 0 business days, shipped on 5 March: 2 calendar days less 0, an overrun of 2, so USD 4.00.
2. The same order shipped on 4 March: an overrun of 1, so USD 2.00.
3. The same order shipped on 3 March: an overrun of 0, so no allowance.

The dates and the handling figure are example inputs.
